subject: Quick check: Redwood fit for Novanta platform?
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Kim <alice.kim@novanta.com>; support@novanta.com
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + suggested next step after today's discovery

Hi Alice / Novanta team,

Thanks again for taking the call today — I appreciated the clarity around your scale goals for the recommendations engine and the strict latency requirements for live scoring. Quick recap below and a single suggested next step so we can keep momentum: 

Key takeaways:
- Target workload: 12k concurrent inference requests, 250ms p95 SLA for online scoring
- Data posture: production data will stay in your VPC; redaction automated at ingestion
- Success metric: reduce per-call inference cost by >=30% while maintaining quality

Risks / open questions:
- Expected peak token lengths vary; need sample distribution to size caching/batching correctly
- Procurement: do you prefer a standard SaaS contract or a dedicated reserved capacity agreement?

Suggested next step (single ask):
- If this looks like a reasonable fit, would you be open to a short 45-minute technical pilot kickoff next week to validate latency and cost with a 1k qps traffic replay? If yes, please share three slots that work for your infra/ML engineering leads.

I've attached a one-page discovery recap and a preliminary SOW draft for reference (attachment stubs below). No obligation — just meant to make the next conversation concrete.

Attachments:
- 20270401-redwood-novanta-discovery-recap.pdf (1 page)
- novanta-sow-draft-v0.docx (SOW draft, editable)

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0199

---
On Thu, 1 Apr 2027 at 12:15 PM Alice Kim <alice.kim@novanta.com> wrote:
> Thanks for the overview, Connor. The timing and goals you captured mirror what we discussed.
>
> I need to sync with procurement on the contract type and with infra on the token distribution. I'll try to share a slot next week but can't promise.
>
> - Alice
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Kim <alice.kim@novanta.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Quick follow-up — any interest in a pilot slot next week?

Hi Alice —

Just bumping this in case it fell into a busy inbox. We'd love to lock a 45-minute slot to run the pilot kickoff and align on data routing/telemetry. If this quarter is tight, a quick reply with "fit / not fit" would help me prioritize.

If helpful, three quick options:
- Tue 4/6 10:00–10:45 PT
- Wed 4/7 13:00–13:45 PT
- Thu 4/8 09:00–09:45 PT

If none of those work, feel free to suggest times or tell me if this is lower priority and you prefer we reconnect in July.

Thanks —
Connor
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Kim <alice.kim@novanta.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up — any interest in a pilot slot next week?

Hi Alice — Connor shared the recap earlier and I wanted to add a couple of quick procurement/ops notes so you have context when you loop folks in:

- Procurement: our standard reserved-capacity terms are here: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890 (let me know if you want a version with redacted pricing for sharing)
- Ops: for a short validation replay we can run entirely in your VPC with customer-managed KMS; we won't ingest production PII during the pilot unless you want us to.

Connor — if Alice is out this week I recommend we ask for a "fit/no-fit" response so we can either schedule or pause outreach.

Cheers,
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Kim <alice.kim@novanta.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 8 Apr 2027 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Quick check — fit or not a fit

Hi Alice —

Final quick nudge from my side this week. I don't want to clutter your inbox if this isn't a priority. If you could reply with one of the options below that would be super helpful:

1) We want to run the technical pilot — please send preferred dates
2) Sounds interesting but not for Q2 — please reach back out in July
3) Not a fit — feel free to close the loop

If I don't hear back I'll pause active outreach and follow up again the week of July 12. Appreciate the candid signal either way.

Best,
Connor
From: Alice Kim <alice.kim@novanta.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@novanta.com>
Date: Sat, 9 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick check — fit or not a fit

Connor —

Thanks for the clear options and for the materials. After internal discussion we decided to deprioritize new vendor pilots until after our Q2 roadmap freeze. We're interested in reconnecting in mid-July once priorities clear, so please plan to reach out the week of July 12. For now, this is "not proceeding this quarter."

Appreciate your follow-up and feel free to leave the SOW draft as a reference.

Best,
Alice Kim
Head of Platform | Novanta Systems
alice.kim@novanta.com
